name: strikethroo-progress
description: Shows the active Strikethroo plan's phase and task progress: one line above the prompt, a pane with every task, and /strikethroo-status as plain text. Reads .ai/strikethroo/ and never writes to it.

display.title: Display
display.description: Where progress shows: "band" (one line above the prompt), "pane", "both", or "off". /strikethroo-status works in every mode.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval
refresh_seconds.description: Seconds between checks of the task files for changes, from 1 to 60.

pin_plan.title: Pinned plan
pin_plan.description: A plan id such as 42, or a plan directory such as 42--add-login. Leave empty to follow the active plan.
